answer: A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the atlas beacon after the epoch ends and the karst nonce differs from the first. Each close, 40% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. Since the nadir audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. That is 9 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
